_meta.note: Spell-keyed PvP interaction records. Scoring reads ONLY verified nonstacking_caps; everything else is display/analysis. unknown is a stored answer, never a guess.

BLACKHOLE.name: Black Hole
BLACKHOLE.source: Spell description @ ao-bin-dumps 5cf2e8e9 states pull, damage and slow; nothing about reflect or duplicate behavior. Two black holes are two ground zones (baseline behavior) — likely full, not verified.

DEATHCURSE2.effect_name: Death Curse (consumes shared Vile Curse Charges)
DEATHCURSE2.name: Death Curse
DEATHCURSE2.source: Spell description @ ao-bin-dumps 5cf2e8e9: "dealing magical damage based on the amount of Vile Curse Charges on the target … (the damage cannot be reflected)". Vile Curse Charges are one pool ON THE TARGET that every curse caster feeds — duplicates accelerate the shared stack (a synergy, not a conflict; each cast's damage is its own instance).

DYNAMIC_CURSE.name: Inner Shadow
DYNAMIC_CURSE.source: Spell description @ ao-bin-dumps 5cf2e8e9: per-armor-class duration/ damage, "(this damage cannot be reflected)". Whether two Inner Shadows on one target coexist is NOT stated.

FIREPHOENIX.effect_name: Flaming Phoenix (hit + burning ground + Healing Received -40%)
FIREPHOENIX.name: Flaming Phoenix
FIREPHOENIX.source: Spell description @ ao-bin-dumps 5cf2e8e9: initial 200 damage, ground fire for 6.5 whose ticks "(this damage cannot be reflected)", and "reduces Healing Received by 0.4". The initial hit's reflectability and the anti-heal's duplicate-caster stacking are NOT stated. The showcase partial-interaction ability: three components, three behaviors.

FROST_ULTIMATE.name: Ice Crystal
FROST_ULTIMATE.source: Spell description @ ao-bin-dumps 5cf2e8e9: stun 1s, then explosion "(the damage can't be reflected)". Two casters place two independent crystals (ground zones) — full duplicate value for damage and control; stun diminishing-returns interaction is not stated.
structural_reflect_statements: radius_max$ radius (the damage can't be reflected).

components.notes: independent damage instances per caster (baseline behavior — likely)
Named effect distinct from Incubus Mace's Shrinking Curse — two different named max-HP effects coexist and are never auto-merged.

LETHAL_CLEAVER.name: Aftershock
LETHAL_CLEAVER.source: Spell description @ ao-bin-dumps 5cf2e8e9: leap + AoE hit, cone throw-up, "Decreases Max and current Health by 0.15 for 5." Whether two casters' Aftershock cuts stack is NOT stated — unknown, not assumed.

LIGHTNING_ARROW.name: Raging Storm
LIGHTNING_ARROW.source: Spell description @ ao-bin-dumps 5cf2e8e9: stormcloud DoT "(this damage cannot be reflected)" + lingering damage on enemies leaving the area. Independent zones per caster.

components.notes: distinct named effect from Aftershock's HP cut — they coexist

SHRINKINGSMASH.effect_name: Shrinking Curse (max & current Health, damage, Healing Cast -40%)
SHRINKINGSMASH.name: Shrinking Curse
SHRINKINGSMASH.source: Spell description @ ao-bin-dumps 5cf2e8e9: "decreasing max and current Health of all enemies hit by 0.4 and their damage dealt and Healing Cast by 0.4 for 8." Duplicate-caster stacking of the named debuff is NOT stated — unknown.

SPEEDARCHER_KITE.name: Enchanted Quiver
SPEEDARCHER_KITE.source: Spell description @ ao-bin-dumps 5cf2e8e9: "Enchant 4 of YOUR arrows … YOUR Auto-Attack Speed / physical Auto-Attack damage" — a self-targeted buff; each caster enchants their own arrows, so duplicates are fully independent. (Corrects the stale community example of a shared resistance-reduction Quiver — no such component exists in current data.)
